title: Text and terminology pass over the book prose
source_handoff: external review of the Edition 1 draft, findings R05-R12, R19-R22, R25, R29
acceptance_criteria: The page-3 structure claim is scoped to major-family sections, because variants, scenarios and concept chapters deliberately use different structures

The evidence vocabulary is driven by the registry: a schema limitation is badged differently from a coverage gap, an instrument gap and an unstable measurement, using the v4 gap_kind field rather than a new parallel taxonomy
Cross-family comparisons separate controlled contrasts from directional/package contrasts and label v2-11 as a package comparison rather than a one-decision pair
The topology chapter separates topology variables (node count, RF, endpoint routing, network, placement) from layout variables, and no longer describes a package contrast as one topology change
Normalized facts no longer imply that normalisation prevents double-selling; the constraint and concurrency requirement is stated
Family summaries separate the mechanistic trade-off from what the corpus observed
The application-maintained rollup is described as committed atomically, not published; publication language is reserved for copies leaving the transaction
Append-only history improves answerability, not correctness
In-run trials are defined before use and 'repeated' is not used loosely beside Trials: 1
Harness terms (read score, design ids, -retries, owned/legacy model, app-99) are defined on first use or moved to the appendix
The read score is defined before the first multiplier that uses it
Forward references carry a one-sentence definition of the mechanism they point at
Range, ratio and transition typography is consistent between prose and generated cards
